- `analysis/` (data.mjs, fit_model.mjs, PATTERNS.md) · `underwriting_model.json|js`
- `quote_desk.html` — portfolio-trained quote engine (profile → category → expected loss → accept/decline → competitive price → law-of-large-numbers sim)

## Platform 2 (company underwriting console) — Claude lane
